scope: M9-M21 historical single-chain runs; no new inference
legacy_pr_auc_semantics: Historical trainer pr_auc is average precision, not trapezoidal PR area. Downstream frozen ensemble summaries separate AP and AUPRC.
selection_policy: Maximum configured validation selection_metric; first occurrence on ties; legacy f1 fallback when unavailable. Evaluation-only records are identified separately. Epoch-budget completion is not a scheduler-status claim.
